title: HV era
note: HV era per docs/eras/hv.md and its "Decisions taken" (which rule), in the Moon version (v0.5.0: HV with no titanium except the EV output, the End already in MV, and the Moon at the end of HV): refinery (gtceu:refinery, type gtceu:refining, cobalt and molybdenum catalyst) and reformer (gtceu:reformer, type gtceu:reforming, trimmable: WARN if missing), HV drill and greenhouse with the stainless steel drill bit (the titanium one stays registered, hidden, and converts 1:1 into the stainless one), GCYR's first rocket and space suit in HV (stainless and kapton), the clean room's EV circuits, and whole GTM PTFE, epoxy, SBR and gasoline. The Moon (DECISIONS 2026-10-24, option A): the trip (synthetic viaje-luna: the rocket, the suit, rocket fuel and oxygen) gives the dim:gcyr:luna key, which the lunar ores need by hand (the menas-luna rule: a one-off start, not a resupplied resource) and the recipes that are only valid on the Moon (conditions.dimension.asKeysFor: instead of comparing them against the factory's dimension). The lunar drill (gtceu:lunar_drill, type gtceu:lunar_drilling, HV) works there with veins_moon.json's samples: ilmenite (the pack's only titanium) and regolith (helium-3, by day). Kroll titanium (lunar ilmenite -> rutile -> TiCl4 -> EBF -> vacuum freezer, which needs 2 EV circuits) is the output to EV (EV hull, motor and pump); titanium and helium-3 belong to EV and only come from the Moon (onlyFrom exclusivity checks). Base AE2 is still whole in LV (its regression is inherited) and maintenance is off. It inherits from MV the world (with the End), the machines and ALL the targets (regression), except the two End checks that stop holding in HV because the Moon also gives ilmenite and chromite (ilmenita-no-sale-del-end and menas-end-sin-llave). Energy: single-block gtceu:hv_* machines (from the registry) run recipes up to 512 V; eu:ev comes from the HV -> EV transformer on the HV grid; cables, amperage and batteries aren't modeled (nor is the energy path to the Moon: hand-carried batteries or AE2's quantum-bridge EU P2P tunnel). GTM multiblocks (clean room, vacuum freezer, cracker, distillation tower, large chemical reactor, EBF): their power follows GTM 7.5.3's rule (WorkableElectricMultiblockMachine.getMaxVoltage: 2 hatches of the same tier raise it one step), so with 2 MV hatches they run 480 EU/t recipes and with 2 HV hatches, 1,920 EU/t ones. The pack's multiblocks require the HV hatch (their design: 1-2 HV hatches; the pattern allows any tier, but the analysis follows the design). Clean room condition (cleanroom): met if the clean room is built and powered (built once); the sterile one is still unsupported (it's UV's). Only veins the drill's table offers are counted (the ones with drilling recipes; a hidden sample from a set-aside vein doesn't count). The H2 balance is qualitative (a sustained H2 path exists with and without the reformer): quantities aren't modeled. The pack's machine vetoes by recipe name aren't modeled: the HV drill and greenhouse are checked by turning the others off with `without` (operate:...). The EV energy hatch needs an EV assembler (1,920 EU/t) and an EV cutter, the only two EV machines that are modeled.

dimension.note: The lunar base: a recipe only valid on the Moon needs the dim:gcyr:luna key (given by the synthetic viaje-luna) instead of being compared against the factory's dimension.

world.note: Decision of 2026-10-24 (Moon, option A): the first rocket trip (the dim:gcyr:luna key) brings back by hand 2 ores of each lunar vein the lunar drill's table offers (veins_moon.json; GCYR's own veins are removed), plus surface regolith and lunar sand: these make the lunar drill's samples and legs. It's a one-off start, not a resupplied resource: the lunar drill keeps it coming after that.

machines.note: GTM's HV <-> EV transformer (1 A).
HV -> EV transformer (4 A -> 1 A): the gate to EV.
Single-block HV generator: burns steam.
HV combustion generator: gasoline, diesel, methanol...
HV gas turbine: refinery gas, butadiene, benzene...

EV assembler (a crafting recipe with the EV hull): runs the 1,920 EU/t recipes for the EV energy hatch and its coil. Only this and the EV cutter are modeled: the rest of the EV machines belong to the EV era.
EV cutter: the MPIC chip for the EV energy hatch (1,920 EU/t, clean room).
Kanthal EBF with 2 HV hatches: they count as EV (2,048 V) and 2,900 K (2,700 K + 200 K for the two steps above MV): step 7's nichrome (1,920 EU/t, 2,700 K).

GTM's clean room: plascrete walls, a filter roof and 1 to 3 energy hatches of any tier (with maintenance off, the maintenance slot is plascrete). Controller: HV hull + HV circuit + 3 filters + 2 stainless steel rotors + 2 HV motors. It has no recipes: it's the `cleanroom` condition on GT recipes (met with `run:gtceu:cleanroom`).

GTM's vacuum freezer: frost-proof casing and 1-2 energy hatches; with 2 MV hatches it counts as HV (512 V): it cools hot ingots and makes liquid air (480 EU/t). Controller: 2 EV circuits, which is why it ties titanium to the EV circuit.
GTM's cracker: clean casing, any coil, fluid hatches, muffler; with 2 MV hatches it counts as HV (512 V) and runs cracking (120 to 480 EU/t).

GTM's distillation tower (4 EV circuits in its controller): clean casing, one output hatch per layer and 1-2 energy hatches. It's left for liquid air and general chemistry; crude oil belongs to the refinery.
GTM's large chemical reactor: inert casing (PTFE), PTFE pipes, one coil and 1-2 energy hatches; with 2 MV it counts as HV (512 V): raw gasoline and gasoline (480 EU/t), PTFE, epoxy and SBR.

HV vein drill (family step): same spec and same table as the LV and MV ones plus the End's table (veins_end.json); clean casing, stainless steel frames and a steel-pipe mast (the `parts` here are the fallback: structures.json's rule), 32-parallel cap with an HV hatch and a stainless steel drill bit (or the vanadium one on the End's veins).
HV greenhouse: just the step up (same spec and recipes as MV, 32 cap, clean casing and HV hatch).

Refinery (HV's piece): a 7x3x7 base and a 12-layer column of clean casing and steel pipes, one output hatch per layer, 2 input hatches (crude oil and H2 or steam), an input bus (catalyst), an output bus (carbon) and 1-2 HV energy hatches. It does in one pass what GTM splits between the tower, desulfurization and the cracker.

Catalytic reformer (HV's trimmable piece): 5x5x6 of clean casing, one input hatch (naphtha), three output hatches (benzene, toluene, H2), a catalyst bus and an HV energy hatch. If the H2 balance doesn't close it's removed and the refinery carries on with electrolysis H2.

Syngas plant (hv/syngas_plant.js): 9x7x3, heat-resistant casing gasifier with a ring of Kanthal coils, two clean stainless shift drums with stainless frames, and an absorber column with a tempered glass sight; floor hatches (1-2 HV energy, a feedstock and catalyst bus, an ash bus, 1-2 input, 2-3 output; the `parts` here are the fallback: structures.json's rule). Carbon dust or heavy fuel + steam -> CO + H2, CO shift + steam -> H2 + CO2 with an iron and chromium catalyst; all at 480 EU/t.

Lunar drill (moon/lunar_drill.js): the lunar step of the drill family, with a different shape (a tripod with its legs on the regolith, solar wings made of light sensors and a short mast; the `parts` here are the fallback: structures.json's rule). It only works on the Moon: all its recipes carry .dimension('gcyr:luna'), which here needs the trip's dim:gcyr:luna key. Table veins_moon.json (ilmenite; regolith with helium-3, by day), stainless steel drill bit, 8 EU/t and a 32 cap with an HV hatch. Its power on the Moon (batteries brought by hand, or Earth's through AE2's quantum bridge with a EU P2P tunnel) is modeled as eu:hv.

The engine test stand (the MV one, mv.json) with an HV energy hatch (or two MV ones, which GTM counts as HV): the static firing of the untested rocket engine with rocket fuel (480 EU/t, 400 t) -> gcyr:basic_rocket_motor, the engine's only source (integration/gcyr_launch_road.js).

Composite autoclave (launch_road/composite_autoclave.js, the path to the first rocket): 5x7x4 horizontal pressure vessel, octagonal clean stainless casing over two stainless frame supports, empty chamber, steel-pipe nitrogen line; 1-2 HV energy hatches, an input and an output bus, and 2 input hatches (epoxy and nitrogen). Cures ablative tiles (fiberglass) and wrapped tanks (stainless barrel + para-aramid) at 480 EU/t.

synthetic.note: The HV steam turbine (with a steam need) gives HV energy.
HV combustion generator: gasoline (1,600 EU/mB, the HV power plant's fuel), diesel and the other liquids.
HV gas turbine: refinery gas, benzene, butadiene, naphtha.
GTM's HV -> EV transformer on the HV grid: the HV power plant at 8,192 EU/t or more (gasoline, large boilers and turbines) sustains EV.

The trip to the Moon (DECISIONS 2026-10-24, option A; the flight test is gg_test_gcyr_flight): GCYR's first rocket (scanner, platform with the stainless-frame tower, tanks, engine, seat and the destination chip), the suit with oxygen in the chestplate (vacuum, it suffocates), and rocket fuel (8 B to launch toward the Moon). It gives the dim:gcyr:luna key, which the lunar ores need by hand (menas-luna) and the recipes that are only valid on the Moon (conditions.dimension.asKeysFor). It's capital: after the first trip, Waystones and beds/homes cross for free.

eraResources.label: the Moon
eraResources.note: Decision of 2026-10-24 (Moon, option A): the first rocket reaches the Moon at the end of HV, and whatever comes from there belongs to EV: the trip's ores (the menas-luna rule) and the recipes that are only valid on the Moon (the lunar drill, the quantum seed).

eraResources.label: titanium (lunar ilmenite)
eraResources.note: Decisions of 2026-10-24: titanium arrives in EV and only comes from the Moon; HV goes without titanium (machines, hulls, drill bits, multiblocks, rocket and suit, all stainless steel). Covers everything that is titanium, ilmenite or rutile: also titanium alloys and tools with a titanium head. Exclusivity (v0.5.0): without the Moon none of those keys are reached (out go the End's ilmenite, bauxite's rutile, GTM's metal mix ilmenite and Productive Bees' titanium honeycombs).

eraResources.label: helium-3 (from the Moon; saved for fusion)
eraResources.note: docs/journey.md: what only comes from the Moon is titanium and helium-3 (from regolith, with the lunar drill, by day). Exclusivity (v0.5.0): without the Moon it isn't reached (out goes the End's stone dust one).

eraResources.label: Mars
eraResources.note: Mars arrives at the end of EV; like the Moon with titanium, what it brings belongs to the next era (IV). To be reviewed when designing EV.

eraResources.label: tungsten (Mars, at the end of EV)
eraResources.note: Opens IV (tungsten steel). Covers tungsten, scheelite, tungstite and whatever is made from them (tungsten steel, carbides).
